Another huge update!

- added deep sky objects / window tab for that category

listing.name: OhMyStars
listing.abstract: This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!
listing.description:
This mod adds constellation lines between stars in KSA!

Features: 
- Constellation (Asterism) Lines between stars  
- Constellation Boundary lines (IAU defined) - Star informational window  
- Star names and informational window  
- Vehicle orientation mode to point towards stars  

---

`*** NEW - as of 1.7.0!`

- DSO (deep sky objects) catalog added with it's own mod tab menu similar to the existing Stars and Multi tabs!
- Space Telescope part modeled after the Hubble Space Telescope added!
- Telescope tab added to the mod window (only when the currently active vehicle includes it as a part) and when active and powered it gives a zoomed and brightened viewport!


`*** NEW - as of 1.6.0!`

- Created a new catalog of stars incorporating several different catalogs information, primarily AT-HYG 4.0, WDS (Washington Double Stars), Sixth Catalog of Orbits of Visual Binary Stars
- Added Multiple star systems as  clickable and filterable things to select from the background when in a new 'Multi' window tab!
- In the new 'Multi' tab stars which are Multiple star systems show the various star components within it as the catalog lists including a visual plot if data supports it!

`*** NEW - as of 1.5.0!`

- Added a star selector method by clicking with cursor / mouse!
- Added a stars binary generator from catalog files with filters, as well as exporting binaries as the game currently has loaded and set for stars color and size!
- Added a constellations (sky cultures) adding and editing feature to the editor window!  You can make your own constellations between stars!

![OMShunter](ksa-image:OMSHunter)

A pointer can be enabled showing the direction to a currently selected star.  A navball marker can be enabled showing the orientation where the selected star is in relation to your vehicle's pointing!

![OMS3medium](ksa-image:OhMyStars3)

An orientation mode can be activated making the flight computer aim your vehicles towards the currently selected star!  Toggle the mode off to go back to the vehicle's previous orientation mode!
